entities.summary: Olivier Roller is a French photographer based in Paris. He specializes in photographic portraits, and since 2009 he has been creating photographic frescos. The images are about individuals of power, which he places in settings or poses reminiscent of historic portraits, from antiquity to Napoleon, creating portraits of the "emperors of today.". Olivier Roller was a painters & sculptors from Strasbourg (b. 1971-12-17, Strasbourg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
